integrity: Analytic proof with exact finite arithmetic and high-precision supporting diagnostics; first-public date from arXiv v1 submission, not journal date. Independent historical priority and proof audit remain unperformed.
scientific_limitations: One scalar unknown, identical unit rows, finitely many distinct fixed measurement values, fixed exponential weight, exact projection, independent resampling. Unique-largest-gap assumption for the sharp two-block spectral coefficient. Does not apply to adaptive weighting, multi-dimensional Kaczmarz, or tied largest gaps.
title: Squared-corruption stationary bias and a sharp largest-gap relaxation law for residual-weighted Kaczmarz
